ai_summary: Maharashtra ration cards (MahaFood) provide subsidised PDS foodgrains under NFSA/state schemes.
ai_explanation: The Maharashtra Food, Civil Supplies department issues ration cards classifying households (Priority/APL/BPL) for subsidised foodgrains through Fair Price Shops under NFSA and state schemes. Aadhaar-seeded cards enable DBT/portability.
